gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-telugu: Expressive and a little odd, Tektur draws every curve with a pipe-cleaner line and gaps at the terminals, while Anek Telugu follows in plain sans with wide, generous bowls. Tektur does its best work big and brief.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anuphan: Distinctive from the first glance, Tektur looks laser-cut from a single sheet, and Anuphan sits beneath it in sans-serif with big round bowls and clear gaps. Their strongest trait is contrast.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-arimo: Tektur's skeleton-outline letters keep one fixed stroke thickness, giving the heading a wiry, engineered look on the page. And Arimo, in sans-serif, settles into a long read with its spacious gaps and lofty mean line.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Tektur holds one unbroken line weight from terminal to junction. It excels at loud, quirky headings, while Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, a sans-serif, offers spaced-out, breathing letters that keep running text easy on the eye.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-chivo: Compass-pencil precision, drawn in lines that never waver. Tektur sets that tone up top, and Chivo, a sans-serif with lowercase packed close to the caps, brings visible daylight through every curve below.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-chocolate-classical-san: A strange, fixed-nib look. Tektur keeps one pen width throughout, and Chocolate Classical Sans, a sans-serif, carries a sizable lowercase with broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut, so paragraphs move along easily.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans keeps its small letters wide open and its bodies dominant, with ascenders barely showing. Against Tektur's spaghetti-like, same-width strokes, the strongest quality is how differently the two draw a line.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-fresca: Tektur's outsized lowercase and open terminals make it unmistakable. If the heading shrinks, that charm fades, whereas Fresca, a sans-serif with short ascenders above big bowls, keeps its counters connected to the outside.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-funnel-sans: Tektur opens every curve at the terminal and gives its lowercase outsized proportions, a look that is hard to miss. Funnel Sans keeps its stroke widths steady beneath, so the page stays grounded.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-gafata: Tektur's lowercase is oversized and its curves are left generously open. It is best at making a loud, hairline-free heading, whereas Gafata is best at a sans body with wide-eyed e shapes and short stalks.
